description: A requirement tree for AI coding: rules inherit down the tree, the AI gets only the rules for the branch it is working on, and you can see what it is working on.
config.title: ReqTree
config.language: Language of the ReqTree panels and messages.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
config.askQuestions: When the recorder is unsure (does a rule cover the whole project or just this part, does it replace an old rule, is a requirement done), it records the most likely option and asks you.
config.askQuestions.notify: Ask with a notification (it does not block you)
config.askQuestions.panel: Only show the count on the side bar icon; answer with "ReqTree: Questions waiting for you"
config.askQuestions.off: Don't ask; keep the recorder's choice
config.memoryMode: How ReqTree and Claude Code's auto memory divide the work.
config.memoryMode.dedupe: Divide the work (default): the tree holds the project's rules; auto memory keeps only things unrelated to the project's content (you, your tools and machine, private details such as servers and accounts). The recorder moves rules the AI writes into memory into the tree, and the check-up deletes notes already in the tree and asks about the rest
config.memoryMode.treeOnly: Turn off auto memory for this project (writes "autoMemoryEnabled": false to .claude/settings.local.json); the tree is the only record. Notes about your tools, machine and private details then have nowhere to go
